snippet.title: June 21st Sunday Service
snippet.description:
Do you find it challenging to live in our modern culture while also living for God?

Join us today as Elder Greg Nelson continues us our series “Behind Enemy Lines.” We will examine how Daniel and his friends were able to live within a foreign culture while continue to live for and honor God.

Grab a family member or roommate, invite or share with a friend, and join in with us!

#myjubileechurch #behindenemylines #onlineservice
